mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE stay_dates (stay_date) AS ( SELECT CAST(#{checkIn} AS DATE) UNION ALL SELECT CAST(TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, 1, stay_date) AS DATE) FROM stay_dates WHERE TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, 1, stay_date) < #{checkOut} ) SELECT MIN(GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(available_stock, capacity), capacity - booked), 0)) FROM ( SELECT d.stay_date, r.stock AS capacity, s.available_stock, COALESCE(SUM(o.room_count), 0) AS booked FROM room r CROSS JOIN stay_dates d LEFT JOIN room_daily_stock s ON s.room_type_id = r.id AND s.stay_date = d.stay_date LEFT JOIN hotel_order o ON o.room_type_id = r.id AND o.order_status IN ('待支付', '未支付', '已支付') AND o.check_in <= d.stay_date AND o.check_out > d.stay_date WHERE r.id = #{roomTypeId} GROUP BY d.stay_date, r.stock, s.available_stock ) nightly_stock
